channel.title: Joe — Vendor Security Advisories
channel.description: Security advisories and PSIRTs from network and infrastructure vendors in use.

item.title: 🔴 Fabric API Authentication bypass
item.description:
Why this matters: Authentication bypass — review access controls and look for unauthorized access.

CVSSv3 Score: 4.9

A Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key [CWE-321] in FortiSandbox and FortiSandbox Cloud API may allow an unauthenticated attacker to access some endpoints via specially crafted HTTP requests

Revised on 2026-10-13 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 1d

item.title: 🔴 Improper access control and session management in the web management interface
item.description:
Why this matters: Authentication bypass — review access controls and look for unauthorized access.

CVSSv3 Score: 9.6

An Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability [CWE-288] in FortiSandbox GUI may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication via crafted HTTP requests.

Revised on 2026-10-13 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 1d

item.title: 🟠 arbitrary command execution in fgfmsd daemon
item.description:
Why this matters: Infrastructure/vendor signal — compare your installed versions and support status.

CVSSv3 Score: 5.3

An improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability [CWE-78] in FortiManager fgfmd daemon may allow a remote attacker impersonating a fortimanager cluster node to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets. Impersonation of a Fortimanager cluster node requires possessing the node's certificate and private key.

Revised on 2026-10-13 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1d

item.title: 🔵 HTML injection in WebUI
